title: Remove Diagnostics tail target setter flat export
summary: Made Diagnostics bridge tail-target selection namespace-first and removed the Diagnostics parent setDiagnosticsTailTarget transitional flat window assignment.
reason: Continue the opportunistic WebView flat-export cleanup while preserving the Diagnostics bridge handoff behavior and avoiding frontend mutation or media-policy changes.
behavior_before: diagnosticsBridge.js invoked window.setDiagnosticsTailTarget directly for tail handoffs, requiring diagnosticsView.js to keep a parent flat compatibility assignment for setDiagnosticsTailTarget.
behavior_after: diagnosticsBridge.js resolves the tail-target setter from window.mediaPipelineDiagnosticsView or window.mediaPipelineDiagnosticsTailView before falling back to the legacy flat name, and diagnosticsView.js no longer assigns window.setDiagnosticsTailTarget.
tests_added: Extended tests.python.desktop.test_application_facade_local_api.LocalApiServerTests.test_local_api_serves_read_only_web_prototype to assert the Diagnostics namespace export remains present and the setDiagnosticsTailTarget flat assignment is absent.

Extended tests.python.desktop.test_application_facade_web_static.ApplicationFacadeWebStaticTests.test_diagnostics_ui_hardening_affordances_are_static_pinned to assert Diagnostics bridge tail-target selection is namespace-first.
rollback_plan: Restore the window.setDiagnosticsTailTarget assignment in diagnosticsView.js, restore the bridge direct flat lookup if needed, regenerate WebView contract/inventory/summaries, and remove the corresponding namespace-first static assertions.
